resources.string: A pause and a question before anything opens. End it any time.
Blocked apps stay closed. Only your session password ends it early.
Blocked apps disappear, and there is no way out until it ends.
Saved. It will show when something is held back.
That file could not be used. Try a picture, GIF or short clip under 40 MB.
You wrote this when you made your promise.
Pinehold’s settings open again when it ends.
A Sealed promise has no way out until it ends. This stops Pinehold being uninstalled or stopped while it runs.
Turning this off lets Pinehold be uninstalled.
On Pinehold for Windows, open You and choose Link with my phone. Type the code it shows.
Laptop linked. Promises now hold on both.
That code did not work. Check it, or get a new one on the laptop.
Ending it early asks for your session password.
You have no session password yet, so nobody can end this early, including you. You wait it out. Set one in You.
A Firm promise ends early only with your session password. Your streak starts again.
This is a Firm promise and no session password is set, so it can\'t be ended early. It ends by itself when the time is up.
Set. Ends a Firm promise early.
Not set. Without one, Firm can\'t be ended early.
At least 8 characters. There is no recovery: forget it and you wait the promise out. It\'s best if someone you trust sets it.
Off. Rules can be loosened freely.
On. Loosening a rule needs your session password.
Type your session password to open your settings for 10 minutes.
Your settings are open for 10 minutes.
Settings are locked. Open them in You > Settings lock with your session password.
Their email. To end a Firm promise early you\'ll need a code we send them, with the words you wrote. Leave it empty for no one.
That doesn\'t look like an email address.
We emailed a 6-digit code to %1$s, with the words you wrote. Type the code they give you.
Sign in first: the code is sent through your Pinehold account.
Three codes have been sent this hour. Try again later.
That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
Pinehold couldn\'t reach its server, so no code was sent.
Other browsers, galleries, app stores and the Google app stay closed until it ends. Search through the Keeper instead.
